commands.label: copy-proof
args: import pathlib,hashlib,sys,json;scan=lambda r:{str(p.relative_to(r)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()for p in r.rglob('*')if p.is_file()};a=scan(pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]));b=scan(pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2]));assert a and a==b;print(json.dumps(a))

commands.label: btrfs-five-external-device-stat
args: import json,pathlib,sys;ps=[pathlib.Path(x)for x in json.loads(sys.argv[1])];assert len(set(ps))==5 and all(p.is_absolute()and p.exists()for p in ps);print(json.dumps({str(p):p.stat().st_dev for p in ps}))
